proof_body:
by
  intro f L M hf h1 h2
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (h1.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds L one_pos))
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := Filter.eventually_atBot.1 (h2.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds M one_pos))
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := A) (b := B)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf.continuousOn
  refine ⟨max C (max (|L| + 1) (|M| + 1)), fun x => ?_⟩
  by_cases hx1 : B ≤ x
  · have h3 := Metric.mem_ball.1 (hB x hx1)
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at h3
    have h4 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (f x) L
    exact le_trans (by linarith) ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  · by_cases hx2 : x ≤ A
    · have h3 := Metric.mem_ball.1 (hA x hx2)
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at h3
      have h4 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (f x) M
      exact le_trans (by linarith) ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
    · push_neg at hx1 hx2
      exact (hC x ⟨hx2.le, hx1.le⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (L M : ℝ), Continuous f → Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds L) → Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atBot (nhds M) → ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x, |f x| ≤ K
